name: SCZ Speedcubing Party 2023

venue.name: Residencial Siles
venue.address: Los Cuarteles 572, Santa Cruz de la Sierra

information: This competition is open to all public. This time we want to offer you a different tournament, where the competitors, in addition to participating, will be able to socialize with each other, having fun in the pool and having a good time, with the registration fee they will be able to enjoy the place and have lunch in the same place. There will be few spaces so be attentive to the networks of the [Asociacion Cruceña de SpeedCubing](https://www.facebook.com/acspeedcubing) to be able to win a place and not miss the tournament. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCZSpeedcubingParty2023#32715-instrucciones-de-pago) **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCZSpeedcubingParty2023#32714-preguntas-frecuentes-faq)** Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. Esta vez queremos ofrecerles un torneo diferente, donde los competidores ademas de participar podran confraternizar entre ellos, divirtiendose en la piscina y pasando un buen rato, con el costo de la inscripcion podran disfrutar del lugar y almorzar en el mismo lugar. Habran pocos espacios asi que esten atentos a las redes de la [Asociacion Cruceña de SpeedCubing](https://www.facebook.com/acspeedcubing) para poder ganar un lugar y no perderse el torneo. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCZSpeedcubingParty2023#32715-instrucciones-de-pago) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBalJMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f94ffdc6b32d68dfef98c05a5dc16aaddd344dd/Logo%20para%20establecimiento%20de%20bebidas%20bubble%20tea%20con%20tapioca%20colorido%20verde%20y%20rosa.png) **Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SCZSpeedcubingParty2023#32714-preguntas-frecuentes-faq)**
